data.change_summary: Extended provenance metadata support beyond process coefficients by adding adjacent `param_meta` maps plus `param_value`/`format_param`/`check_ranges` support to `SourceWaterPreset` and `ShrimpPreset`, with unknown-key validation wired into their normal validators. Tightened `ProcessParamsPreset::validate()` so the two DIC rate fields are checked for finite non-negative values, documented that legacy `_mg`/`_mg_total` `valid_range` bounds must use normalized concentration units, and updated the normal preset loaders to surface range warnings through explicit diagnostics while preserving backward-compatible loading. Revalidated the pending habitat-registry state-preservation amendment as well; the failing validation test already passes in the current tree, so no engine-side change was required there.
outstanding_risks: Callers that deserialize presets directly with `toml::from_str` still bypass loader-emitted diagnostics unless they invoke `validate()` and `check_ranges()` themselves or adopt the new `load_*_with_diagnostics()` helpers.

The normal `load_source_water()`, `load_shrimp()`, and `load_process_params()` paths surface range diagnostics via stderr strings; callers that need structured warning handling must use the new `*_with_diagnostics` APIs.

Shipped preset TOML files still do not contain real per-parameter provenance entries for source-water or shrimp data yet; this change adds the schema and loader support, but the downstream metadata-enrichment bead still needs to populate it.

The worktree contains unrelated pre-existing changes in `crates/tank_api/src/handlers/snapshot.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/mod.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs`, untracked `crates/tank_harness/tests/discover_baselines.rs`, and untracked `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.

steps.description: Inspected the pending amendments against the current tree, confirmed the habitat-registry validation regression test already passes as written, and narrowed the remaining work to provenance-schema, loader-diagnostic, and preset-validation gaps.

Extended `SourceWaterPreset` and `ShrimpPreset` with per-parameter `param_meta` storage plus shared lookup/format/range-check helpers, and wired unknown metadata-key rejection into their validators so chemistry and biology presets can carry parameter-level provenance without breaking legacy TOML files.

Updated process provenance handling by adding the two DIC rate fields to the finite/non-negative validation set, documenting normalized `valid_range` semantics for legacy `_mg`/`_mg_total` fields, and adding a matching developer note in `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml`.

Refactored the normal source-water, shrimp, and process loaders to validate through a shared diagnostic path, added `load_*_with_diagnostics()` helpers for structured warning collection, and ensured the existing loader APIs now emit explicit range-warning diagnostics instead of silently dropping them.

Added regression coverage for source-water and shrimp parameter metadata, loader diagnostic formatting, defaulted/optional biology fields, and the missing DIC-rate validation, then ran the targeted library and validation test suites across `tank_data`, `tank_core`, and `tank_scenarios`.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_data --lib` passed: 22 tests passed, 0 failed, including new coverage for source-water/shrimp `param_meta`, loader diagnostics, and DIC-rate validation.
`cargo test -p tank_core --lib provenance` passed: 11 provenance tests passed, 0 failed.

`cargo test -p tank_core --test validation` passed: 11 tests passed, 0 failed, including `step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error`, confirming the pending engine-state regression is not present in the current tree.
`cargo test -p tank_scenarios --lib` passed: 4 tests passed, 0 failed, confirming scenario materialization still compiles and loads through the updated preset APIs.

`git diff --stat -- crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml` showed the scoped source delta for this turn in those provenance/loader files only.
